order_title: Insulated Flask, Bottles and Containers for Domestic Use (Quality Control) Order, 2023
issuing_department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
enabling_act: Section 16, Section 17 and Subsection (3) of Section 25 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (11 of 2016)
standard_mark: Standard Mark (ISI Mark) under Scheme-I of Schedule-II of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018
scope_description: Domestic stainless steel vacuum flasks, bottles, and insulated beverage containers intended for domestic use.
exemptions: Goods or articles meant for export conforming to any specification required by the foreign buyer; micro and small enterprises registered under Udyam portal receive staggered compliance timelines.
